title: Suspension in the module projective model is the cochain shift
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, and equip all unbounded $R$-module cochain complexes with the projective model structure of [lem-coef-projective-cochain-monoidal-model], using [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] for cochains, quasi-isomorphisms and shifts. Thus $Q[1]^n=Q^{n+1}$ with differential $-d_Q$. For every cofibrant complex $Q$, form $C(Q)^n=Q^n\oplus Q^{n+1}$ with differential $(b,a)\mapsto(d_Qb+a,-d_Qa)$ and inclusion $Q\to C(Q)$ given by $b\mapsto(b,0)$. This inclusion is a cofibration and $C(Q)$ is cofibrant and contractible. The span $C(Q)\leftarrow Q\to C(Q)$ represents the span $0\leftarrow Q\to0$ in the homotopy coherent localization. Its ordinary pushout has terms $Q^n\oplus Q^{n+1}\oplus Q^{n+1}$ and differential $(b,a_1,a_2)\mapsto(d_Qb+a_1+a_2,-d_Qa_1,-d_Qa_2)$. Projection $(b,a_1,a_2)\mapsto a_2$ is a quasi-isomorphism from this pushout to $Q[1]$, natural in maps of cofibrant complexes. Consequently the suspension induced on the ordinary homotopy category is naturally isomorphic to $[1]$. The homotopy coherent localization is stable in the sense of [lem-coef-pointed-model-stability]: it has a zero object and finite homotopy limits and colimits, and a square is a homotopy pushout if and only if it is a homotopy pullback.
